diagnosis: The rollout settlements consistently set 'denied_token_logging_enabled' to true, which is the default value. This allowed check C5 to pass even though PF2, which specifies logging settings, was never accessed by any of the lone decision-makers. Additionally, the 'rollout_mode' was set to 'full' or 'gradual', which did not require the specific details from PF2.

C5.why: The shared rollout plan does not specify audit controls, while PF2 changes logging to enabled, retention to exactly 180 days, and break-glass access to two-person approval.
